reuse.why: Extends the existing shared assertBankAccountLinkable guard uniformly, but releaseAccountLinks re-writes the unlinkAccount field-clearing update instead of sharing it with the unlink action.

duplication.why: The null-out updateAccount block in releaseAccountLinks is a copy of the one inside unlinkAccount; otherwise each handler only adds a uniform call.

placement.why: The flag is handled in the existing link guard and the release helper sits beside it in accounts/app.ts, matching where link rules live.

scope.why: Changes are limited to the flag, the guard's return value and one release call per link handler.

maintainability.why: One guard decides refusal vs takeover for all six providers, which is easy to own; the only liability is the second definition of the unlinked state.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All handlers go through assertBankAccountLinkable; nothing bypasses an existing abstraction.

disguised_duplication.where: releaseAccountLinks in accounts/app.ts copies the unlinkAccount clearing block openly.
